Spartan Headlines

American Rivers Conference Makes Announcement Regarding Fall 2020 Intercollegiate Athletics

Aug 11, 2020

As many of you know, the American Rivers Conference (A-R-C) and its presidents were the last Division III Conference in the country to support a modified fall sports schedule. We believe that participation is critical to the healthy formation of students. Late last week, after the A-R-C’s announcement, the NCAA issued a set of last-minute mandates that made both implementation and participation in fall 2020 intercollegiate athletics nearly impossible.

44 Spartans Named to A-R-C Spring All-Academic Team

Jun 22, 2020

Despite a majority of the spring season being canceled due to COVID-19, the American Rivers Conference has released the All-Academic teams to honor the spring athletes that excelled in the classroom and have a cumulative grade point average of 3.50 or better.

Cain Named CoSIDA Academic All-District

May 21, 2020

The College Sports Information Directors of America (CoSIDA) released the 2020 NCAA and NAIA At-Large Academic All-District Teams on Thursday afternoon, with UD wrestler Ethan Cain making the list for NCAA Division III District Eight.

A-R-C Presidents Council Announces Hopeful Return for Fall Athletics

May 15, 2020

The Presidents Council of the American Rivers Conference today announced its intention to conduct intercollegiate athletics programs this fall and for the entirety of the 2020-21 academic year.

Barista Named to 2020 NFF Hampshire Honor Society

Apr 15, 2020

The National Football Foundation & College Hall of Fame (NFF) announced today the members of the 2020 NFF Hampshire Honor Society, which is comprised of college football players from all divisions of play who each maintained a cumulative 3.2 GPA or better throughout their college careers.

Pair of Spartan Wrestlers Earn NWCA Academic Award

Mar 31, 2020

The National Wrestling Coaches Association (NWCA) announced the full slate of 2019-2020 Scholar All-American Team and Individual honorees for NCAA Division III with awards going to 283 individuals representing 80 institutions.

Anderson Honored as All-Conference

Mar 26, 2020

The American Rivers Conference announced the the 2019-20 Wrestling All-Conference honorees on Thursday afternoon, with Zarik Anderson being the lone Spartan wrestler on the list.

Smith Named Spartans Women’s Basketball Coach

Mar 20, 2020

The University of Dubuque announces the appointment of Justin Smith as the new head women’s basketball coach.

American Rivers Conference Cancels Rest of Spring Season

Mar 17, 2020

On Friday morning, the American Rivers Conference canceled the remaining of the spring sports season due to the concern of COVID-19.

Softball Season Ends Early with 10-4 Record

Mar 13, 2020

The University of Dubuque softball team finished up their trip to 2020 The Spring Games in Clermont Fla. on Friday afternoon with two victories to finish their season 10-4 overall. UD won the first game on Friday 6-3 over St. Mary's College and would sweep the day with a 9-1 win over Swarthmore College.
